class.dcclasses.miner.desc: Masters of ore extraction and underground labor. Excels at gathering resources and fueling industry, but sacrifices mobility and combat versatility.
class.dcclasses.warrior.desc: A frontline fighter focused on protection and melee combat. Tough and dependable in battle, but less effective at magic and resource gathering.
class.dcclasses.mage.desc: TA wielder of powerful arcane magic. Commands devastating spells and utility abilities, but is physically fragile and vulnerable in close combat.
class.dcclasses.naturalist.desc: Provider of food and renewable resources. Gains strong utility and sustainability bonuses, but is weaker in direct combat and exploration.
class.dcclasses.adventurer.desc: A traveler and scout built for discovery. Moves quickly across the world and locates valuable sites, but lacks durability in dangerous fights.
